findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The fix for the HTML-sanitizer findings replaced the Lithuanian translation of totpStep1 with Italian text ('Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:'). Lithuanian users of the account theme now see an Italian sentence on the OTP setup page. The same Italian string was also introduced in themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties (line 71). Both should be restored to a proper Lithuanian translation.

findings.title: error-invalid-multivalued-size switched from {{n}} to single-brace MessageFormat syntax in the JS UI resource
findings.body: In the account console (React/i18next-based) message bundle, error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from '{{0}} ... {{2}} value(s).' to 'Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,...}'. All other keys in this file use double-brace interpolation (e.g. error-invalid-length on line 140), so the single-brace placeholders and the Java-MessageFormat choice pattern are not interpolated by this UI; users would see literal '{0}', '{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' text. The same change was made to js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources-community/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties (line 3138). If these keys are only rendered server-side via the Java base themes the change is fine, but then the JS copies should be verified against the UI's interpolation format before merging.

findings.title: Missing English sibling file crashes verification with a raw RuntimeException
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() derives the English reference file by regex-replacing the locale suffix of the current file's absolute path, then opens it with new FileInputStream and wraps any IOException in a RuntimeException. If a locale properties file has no *_en.properties sibling in the same directory (e.g. a bundle that intentionally has no English file, or a file whose name does not match the assumed naming scheme), the RuntimeException escapes verify() (which only catches IOException) and aborts the whole build with an unhelpful stack trace instead of being reported as a per-file message or a MojoExecutionException. The failure mode should be a clean, actionable error.

findings.title: Hardcoded per-key exceptions make the sanitizer brittle for future message content
findings.body: normalizeValue() special-cases exactly the keys 'templateHelp', 'optimizeLookupHelp', 'linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit*' and 'error-invalid-multivalued-size' to strip pseudo-HTML/MessageFormat fragments before sanitizing. Any new or existing message that legitimately contains a '<...>' fragment (such as docs examples or another choice-format key) will fail the build, and the only fix is to add another hardcoded key to this private method. A more general mechanism (e.g. an allowlist file or normalizing all {n,choice,...} patterns regardless of key) would avoid repeatedly patching the verifier.
